Validations.Reason: The chapter explicitly depicts the group identifying the barrier as a finite reservoir ('cup') that was saturating, executing a maneuver to drain the Blight into the western drainage channels, and subsequently deciding to move immediately to pursue the flow. Kaelen's collapse and the group's departure are directly described, supporting the advancement of the conflict thread from static defense to active pursuit.

The chapter details Kaelen's active 'pull,' the physical toll (skin cracking, essence leakage, dark veins), and his subsequent collapse into a state identified by Torin as a protective sleep. This materially advances the mystery of Kaelen's limits by confirming he can sustain the pull only briefly and at severe cost, shifting the narrative tension to his incapacitation.

The chapter resolves the immediate mechanical mystery of the barrier's capacity by revealing it is a finite reservoir that can be drained. It establishes the new operational state where the Blight is moving westward through the channels, supported by the dialogue regarding the 'keeper' being dead and the flow heading toward the forest. This materially changes the state of the containment system from static containment to mobile flow.
